## Chapters
- [Key FSM Terms](article_0302025945.md): These Field Service Management (FSM) terms cover the core records, roles, and tools used to schedule, dispatch, and complete field service work: - Asset - An item, location, or piece of equipment that requires service and is tracked in NetSuite.
